sentences.en: He was sweating, and mopped his brow with his tie.
sentences.zh: 他汗流浃背，用领带擦了擦额头。

sentences.en: A bead of sweat started forming on his brow.
sentences.zh: 一滴汗水在他的额头上开始形成。

sentences.en: She pulled out a handkerchief and mopped her brow.
sentences.zh: 她拿出手帕擦了擦额头。

senses.zh: 眉，眉毛,前额,容貌，表情,山脊
